drivers.detail: Inflation changes incumbent support and political standing; business institutions also respond to rising prices.
drivers.label: Prices

drivers.detail: Delivered growth affects incumbent support, political standing and business loyalty. Review construction and the economy behind it.
drivers.label: Economic growth

drivers.detail: Disorder and separatism feed public discontent and the appeal of opposition movements; reforms can change both.
drivers.label: Order and cohesion

drivers.detail: War exhaustion lowers political standing and army loyalty and shifts support away from the government.
drivers.label: War exhaustion

links.label: Ministry budgets

links.label: Construction

links.detail: Political reforms also change relations abroad.
links.label: Diplomacy
